welcome.title: Welcome to Mawred
welcome.description: Let's get your workspace ready. Each step saves as you go, and you can skip the optional ones and come back from Settings.

company.title: Company profile
company.description: Your company's name and logo appear next to the Mawred mark on sign-in, emails, documents and the careers site.
company.legalNameHint: As it appears on contracts and certificates.
company.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
company.logoDrop: Drop your logo here, or choose a file
company.accentHint: Used only in co-branded areas. The app itself keeps Mawred's colours.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Mawred is available in English and Arabic. Everyone can switch at any time; these are the defaults for new users.
languages.hijriHint: Adds the Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date under Gregorian dates.

later.title: Available in a later release
later.description: {step} arrives with {module}. Skip it for now; it will appear in Settings when it's ready.

admin.title: Admin account
admin.description: You're the first Super Admin. Super Admins must use two-factor authentication.
admin.name: Name
admin.twoFactorOff: Turn on two-factor authentication to continue.

review.title: Review & finish
review.description: Here's where things stand. Skipped steps can be finished later from Settings.

done.title: You're all set
done.description: Mawred is ready for your team. Invite people and set up the rest whenever you're ready.

branch.title: Your first branch
branch.description: Where people work: its time zone, weekend and working hours drive leave, schedules and attendance. Add more branches later from Organization.
